'''Cathington's Disorder''' was a rare [[Nervous system|neurological]] disease that was seen in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris's]] [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Dynamet General}}</ref> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Dynamet General Hospital|Dynamet General]], Taris's foremost research [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]], developed a cure for the disorder in the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before Taris's destruction.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cathington's Disorder was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Dynamet General in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
